summary: Iter 8 — Tested sync-feed dashboard, conflict detection on order create, dismiss endpoint, PWA icons, SyncFeed component, OnboardingTour (3 steps + skip + finish + localStorage persistence), containers/labels regression. Backend 10/10 pytest passing. Frontend all critical flows OK.

issues: Repeated warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart containers are being rendered with no dimensions (probably a hidden/collapsed responsive container). Cosmetic but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents that produce width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3477 lines — should be split into modules (orders, sync, dashboard, auth) per SRP / file-size guideline (>700 lines).
OrderLine requires product_name in payload but conflict-detection payload in offline flow may omit it — frontend must always include product_name (currently OK, verified in SyncFeed).

Order conflict logging always inserts a new document even for the same client_uuid resubmit — POST /orders returns existing doc BEFORE conflict-check, which is correct; but a resubmit with different lines under same client_uuid silently returns the first order (idempotency by client_uuid ignores payload diff). Fine for offline resync but potentially confusing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding 3 steps + skip + syncfeed + regression all OK)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ client, 2 TEST_ products (stock 0 and 100), several orders (with and without stock conflict) and 1 TEST_ commercial user via /api/admin/users. Left in DB — safe cleanup recommended by prefix TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 delivery is functionally complete. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_sync_feed.py can be re-run any time (pytest -o addopts=''). Login endpoint returns 'token' not 'access_token'. Client type values: bar|restaurant|caviste|supermarche|hotel|autre (not 'cave'). Product uses 'price' not 'unit_price'. OrderLine requires product_name. Emails using .test TLD are rejected by pydantic EmailStr — use realistic-looking domain like bevid-test.example.com.
